source: The programming model treats the warp as progressing together through the kernel. Hardware implementation details can be more flexible, especially on ZXNAME0000XZ architectures with Independent Thread Scheduling, but portable code must not rely on undocumented sub-warp behavior.[1]
zh: 编程模型将扭曲视为在内核中一起进行。硬件实现细节可以更加灵活，特别是在具有独立线程调度的 ZXNAME0000XZ 架构上，但可移植代码不得依赖于未记录的子扭曲行为。 [1]
